title: Implement automatic peer blacklisting on repeated rejections
description:
If a peer's consecutive_failures exceeds a configurable threshold (default 10), set blacklisted_until to now + configurable duration (default 1 hour). Blacklisted peers are not dialed; inbound connections from blacklisted peers are rejected with 400. Blacklist entries expire automatically. Artifact: transit/src/peering/blacklist.rs.

Acceptance: blacklisting triggers after threshold consecutive failures; blacklist expires after configured duration; operator can manually unblacklist via CLI; blacklist events are logged at warn level
